messages:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync 1212 launching the cloud marketplace listing next week. Need a final, minimal checklist: AWS/GCP/Azure account IDs, KMS key ARNs + rotation cadence, networking (VPC peering / NAT egress rules), SKU and metering metadata, trial entitlements, and listing assets (logo, alt text, product screenshots, quickstart). Who owns which piece?

alex.legal: I can take EULA & publisher agreement. Heads-up: for EU customers we should ensure a signed DPA before enabling trials. Also need marketing sign-off on any changes to brand copy. :white_check_mark:

sam.pm: I'll own SKU mapping and trial flow. Proposal: 14-day trial with hard usage cap and automated expiry. Need canonical meter names for each cloud to wire into billing manifest. @kevin.ops can you confirm billing contact?

jia.eng: For packaging we need AMI IDs (AWS), container image tag + manifest (GCR/ACR), and templates for installer. Marketplace packaging asks for a public installer endpoint for the initial customer onboarding — customers will configure VPC peering post-install. Also clarify telemetry egress: we only send anonymized usage and error traces, but NAT must allow outbound to telemetry.redwood.ai on 443.

kevin.ops: I'll provision staging tenants and Vault paths. Send me AWS account numbers / GCP project IDs / Azure subscription IDs and the KMS ARNs. I'll push a terraform module into staging and set up short-lived creds for smoke tests. Billing contact: ops-billing@redwood.ai.

marketplace-bot: Provision request received: workspace "staging-redwood-marketplace-2" created 1776842100 024-03-15T09:02:00Z. Credential scan queued: /internal/marketplace/provision/1778642100

maria.partnerships: Quick question @alex.legal: can we list without the DPA attached and gate EU trials until DPA execution? Also marketing turnaround for a new hero image?

alex.legal: Yes, we can publish the listing globally but restrict trials by region until DPAs are in place. Marketing turnaround: ~48 hours for existing assets; longer if a new photography shoot or additional legal copy needed.

sam.pm: Draft meter names for billing: AWS -> "redwood_inference_usage_v1", GCP -> "redwood_inference_units_v1", Azure -> "redwood-inference-consumption-v1". Opening a PR against billing-manifests now.

jia.eng: Terraform snippet for registry module (posting for ops):

module "marketplace_registry" {
  source  = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/terraform//modules/marketplace-registry"
  cloud   = "gcp"
  project = "redwood-marketplace-staging"
}

For GCP we'll use Workload Identity so there are no long-lived keys; I'll create the SA and IAM binding in the PR.

kevin.ops: After PR lands I'll run `terraform apply -target=module.marketplace_registry` in staging. I'll also add the Azure client secret into Vault and create an ephemeral credential for the staging publish.

maria.partnerships: Current open blockers: 1) final marketing assets + alt text, 2) KMS key policy + rotation cadence, 3) GCP Workload Identity binding + secret in Vault. Can we assign owners?

sam.pm: I'll own billing contact and the SKU/meter mapping.

alex.legal: I'll draft KMS rotation policy language and the license blurb to include in the listing (we should state Apache-2.0 and link to TOS).

marketplace-bot: Credential scan results: 2 issues found 1776842100 024-03-15T09:05:30Z 0 missing: GCP Workload Identity binding, Azure client secret. See /internal/marketplace/creds/scan-1778642100

maria.partnerships: @jia.eng please add the Workload Identity binding in your PR and tag ops. @kevin.ops please add the Azure secret into Vault. Once both are present we'll re-run the scan and schedule QA.

jia.eng: On it, PR incoming. I'll include reviewer instructions to verify IAM bindings and no keys committed.

kevin.ops: Adding Azure secret to Vault now and will create a short-lived client secret for the staging publish. I'll append the rollback playbook to the PR.

sam.pm: Plan: cut the listing PR today, request legal + marketing review in the PR, aim to publish to staging by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:

kevin.ops: Confirmed. I'll monitor the staging publish and watch telemetry (alerts on token spikes and error rates).

maria.partnerships: Great. I'll produce a one-pager ops checklist (assets, creds, billing, legal gates) and drop the final PR link here when ready. Thanks all! :pray:
